safety: Native code executes inside guest apps. Only owner-reviewed releases should be listed. A separate review is required for every new binary version.

tweakEntries.name: SambaFix
tweakEntries.description: Corrige el inicio de Samba de Amigo sin usar CloudKit real.
tweakEntries.notes: La nube de iCloud queda desactivada; los datos del juego son locales.
tweakEntries.alertMessage: Samba de Amigo necesita SambaFix v3 para superar el problema de CloudKit. Sin este parche el juego puede cerrarse o no iniciar.

entrySchema.name: string
entrySchema.developer: name of the original tweak author or team; credit must match the actual published source
entrySchema.officialSourceURL: optional HTTPS link to original developer repository or official website, displayed as a credit (never used to download executable code)
entrySchema.sha256: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal digest of the actual release asset

supportedApps.bundleID: original bundle ID or installed bundle folder

entrySchema.alertTitle: optional text, shown before launch at level 3
entrySchema.alertMessage: optional explanation, shown before launch at level 3
entrySchema.fileName: stable filename ending in .dylib, no path separators
entrySchema.appStoreID: optional numeric Apple App Store track ID; look up official artworkUrl512
entrySchema.appIconURL: optional direct HTTPS official Apple CDN (mzstatic.com) icon URL; takes precedence over lookup; falls back to installed-app icon if missing/unavailable
